insurer: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Not specified in provided pages (examples shown: ₹3L, ₹5L, ₹10L, ₹15L+; also illustrations up to ₹1 Cr/₹50L/₹25L)

great.name: Pre-existing disease (PED) waiting period: 12 months
great.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 12 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with insurer
great.reference: IV. EXCLUSIONS > 1. Pre-Existing Diseases - Code Excl 01 (Page 6)
great.explanation: PED coverage starts after 12 months of continuous cover, which is better than the common 24-48 months.

great.name: Specified disease/procedure waiting period: 12 months
great.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the following listed Conditions, surgeries/ treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 12 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with us.
great.reference: IV. EXCLUSIONS > 2. Speciﬁed disease / procedure waiting period - Code Excl 02 (Page 6)
great.explanation: Listed specific diseases/procedures are covered after 12 months, which is better than the standard 24 months.

great.name: Built-in Additional Sum Insured buffer for Road Traffic Accident (after base is exhausted)
great.quote: Additional Basic Sum Insured for Road Trafﬁc Accident (RTA)... The additional Basic Sum Insured shall be available after exhaustion of the limit of coverage
great.reference: II. COVERAGE (Applicable for both Silver and Gold Plan) > L. Additional Basic Sum Insured for Road Trafﬁc Accident (RTA) (Page 3)
great.explanation: Provides extra Sum Insured that activates after the base limit is exhausted (for eligible RTA hospitalization).

good.name: Room rent limit: Single Private A/C Room
good.quote: A. Room (Single Private A/C room), Boarding and Nursing Expenses as provided by the Hospital
good.reference: II. COVERAGE - (Applicable for both Silver and Gold Plan) (Page 2)
good.explanation: Single Private AC room is industry-standard. Note: if you choose a higher category than eligible, proportionate deductions can apply.

good.name: Initial waiting period: 30 days (illness)
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the ﬁrst policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.reference: IV. EXCLUSIONS > 3. 30-day waiting period - Code Excl 03 (Page 6)
good.explanation: Standard 30-day initial waiting for illness; accidents are covered from day 1 as per policy terms.

good.name: Restore benefit: 100% restoration once; usable for all claims (but not for Modern Treatment)
good.quote: Automatic Restoration of Basic Sum Insured: There shall be automatic restoration of the Basic Sum Insured once by 100%... Such Restored basic sum insured can be utilized for all claims during the policy period... This Beneﬁt is not available for Modern Treatment
good.reference: II. COVERAGE > J. Automatic Restoration of Basic Sum Insured (Page 3)
good.explanation: Restores 100% of base sum insured once after partial/full utilization and can be used for all claims in the year, but it is not available for Modern Treatments.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization cover: 60 days
good.quote: Pre-hospitalization Expenses: Medical expenses incurred up to 60 days immediately before the insured person is hospitalized
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for 60 days before hospitalization (standard-good range).

good.name: Post-hospitalization cover: 90 days
good.quote: Post Hospitalization Expenses: Medical expenses incurred up to 90 days immediately after the insured person is discharged from the hospital
good.reference: II. COVERAGE > F. Post Hospitalization Expenses (Page 3)
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for 90 days after discharge (standard-good range).

good.name: NCB (Cumulative Bonus): 20% per claim-free year up to 100% (reduces on claim)
good.quote: Cumulative Bonus: The insured person will be eligible for Cumulative bonus calculated at 20% of basic sum insured for each claim free year subject to a maximum of 100% of the basic sum insured
good.explanation: Standard NCB growth. It is not fully protected: the bonus reduces based on claim utilization (as per the special conditions).

bad.name: Consumables not covered (significant out-of-pocket list includes gloves, masks, kits, etc.)
bad.quote:
Other Excluded Expenses
Items for which coverage is not available in the policy
... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ... 58 ANY KIT WITH NO DETAILS MENTIONED [DELIVERY KIT, ORTHOKIT, RECOVERY KIT, ETC] ... 62 OXYGEN MASK ...
bad.explanation: Consumables are largely excluded, which can materially increase out-of-pocket costs during hospitalization.

bad.name: Modern Treatments have sub-limits (not covered at full Sum Insured)
bad.quote: Coverage for Modern Treatments: The expenses payable during the entire policy period for the following treatment / procedure ... is limited to the amount mentioned in table below;
bad.reference: II. COVERAGE > O. Coverage for Modern Treatments (Page 6)
bad.explanation: Modern treatments (e.g., robotic surgeries, stem cell therapy, etc.) are capped by sub-limits, which is a coverage restriction vs policies with no sub-limits.

bad.name: Room category mismatch can trigger proportionate deduction on associated medical expenses
bad.quote: Hospitalisation expenses which vary based on the room rent occupied by the insured person will be considered in proportion to the room rent limit / room category stated in the policy or actuals whichever is less.
bad.reference: II. COVERAGE > Note under A. Room... (Page 2)
bad.explanation: Because room rent is capped to Single Private AC, choosing a higher room category can reduce payable amounts for linked hospital charges (proportionate deductions).

bad.name: NCB reduces on claim and can become nil on full utilization
bad.quote: In the event of a claim resulting in; ... d. Full utilization of Basic Sum Insured and full utilization of cumulative bonus accrued, the cumulative bonus on renewal will be “nil”
bad.reference: II. COVERAGE > K. Cumulative Bonus > Special Conditions (Page 3)
bad.explanation: On claims, the cumulative bonus is reduced and can drop to nil, unlike non-resetting renewal bonuses.

unclear.name: Co-pay (copayment) terms not explicitly stated
unclear.quote: The moratorium would however be subject to all limits, sub limits, co-payments, deductibles as per the policy contract.
unclear.explanation: The wording references co-payments generally, but no explicit co-pay %/age/network condition is provided in the shared pages. Verify from full policy wording/schedule whether any co-pay applies.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
